exposure: Reviewer-specified contrast; aggregate cell means and original within-history intervals already known. Specification written before computing the new interaction interval.
scope: Full-rewrite records at horizon 32, fresh scattered-24 common reader, both-cue success; paired blocks 34000–34031.
direction: Positive means a larger loss under matched-noise rebuilding history.
unit: 32 paired independent blocks, each averaging four founders and four recipients; same block resampled in all four conditions.
bootstrap: 10000 whole-block resamples; reuse original E054 semantic PCG64 bootstrap stream; percentile two-sided 95%, linear quantile interpolation.
seed_specification: SHA256 of compact JSON [E054,bootstrap,record_interventions], first 16 digest bytes as little-endian integer for NumPy PCG64.
multiple_comparisons: One reviewer-requested post hoc interaction, pointwise interval, no correction for outcome-informed selection; does not change original qualification.
additional_reporting: Transcribe the original prespecified policy-by-permutation secondary contrasts separately; no search across interventions, horizons or injuries.
checks: Validate original mean/intervals from saved block summaries, check integer-count arithmetic and an independent resample-by-counts calculation; no simulation module imports.
